answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond and earn a work history before it can trade. A single fake identity is cheap, but a Sybil attacker must fund a bond for each of hundreds of clones, and each clone must complete slow, verifiable jobs before gaining trust, so the cost grows with every copy. Like an ember that dies without fuel, an unfunded identity fades; the umber shadow of copied profiles cannot hide once payments and job receipts are checked against a shared reef of public records, where duplicates and inconsistent histories stand out and bonded funds can be slashed.
